newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-COELBA STILL AN ING BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-COELBA STILL AN ING BUY.

text.p: ING Barings said Monday it has reaffirmed its buy rating on Brazilian power distributor Coelba with a June 1998 target price of $117 per 1,000 shares.

-- In a report, ING Barings analyst Charles Barnett said Coelba's second-quarter net income of 22.9 million reais or 1.21 reais ($1.12) per 1,000 shares was 140 percent above the bank's estimate of $0.46. It posted a $0.56 per-1,000-shares loss in 1996's second quarter.
-- Coelba's net sales of 177 million reais were in line with forecasts and up 13 percent from the period last year, he said.
-- Operating income of 29.6 million reais was up 529 percent year-on-year and 100 percent above expectations, he added.
-- Net interest expense of 7.0 million reais was 250 percent higher than expected but a 50-percent improvement versus second-quarter 1996, Barnett said.
-- "This strong second-quarter result confirms the current turnaround in Coelba's performance, which is likely to accelerate now that the company is in private hands," he wrote.
-- Coelba's preferred share was flat at Friday's closing price of 91.30 reais while its common was down 1.55 percent at 95 reais at 1444 local/1744 GMT in Sao Paulo.
